description_sq: Ne Fresk ,Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti. title_en: In Freske, 1+1 apartment with regular floor plan for sale!!
description_en: In Freske, 1+1 apartment with regular floor plan for sale!! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a bedroom and a toilet. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, making it a very good opportunity for both residence and investment, since the rent requirements are high.
